data.gender_notes: Ambadas is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from 'Amba' (Goddess Durga) and 'Das' (servant). Ambadas represents a devotee or servant of Goddess Durga. The name Ambadas carries the meaning “God's servant” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ambadas usually hope their child will grow to embody god's servant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Loyal and dedicated to the divine.
data.etymology: Ambadas belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's servant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ambadas total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
